name: Verify that all authentication credentials are treated as sensitive data
Verify that passwords are at least 12 characters with no maximum length
Verify that password reset mechanisms do not reveal existing users
Verify that session tokens are generated using a cryptographically secure pseudo-random number generator
Verify that session tokens are revoked upon logout
Verify that access controls are enforced on a trusted service layer
Verify principle of least privilege is applied across roles
Verify that sensitive data and APIs are protected against IDOR / direct object reference
Verify that the application validates all input against an allowlist
Verify that parameterized queries or ORMs are used to prevent injection
Verify that all cryptographic modules use industry-accepted algorithms
Verify that error handling does not leak stack traces or debug information
Verify that TLS is enforced on all connections
Verify that business logic state transitions cannot be skipped or tampered
Verify business logic rate limits, concurrency guards, and replay protections
Verify that file uploads validate file extensions, MIME types, and magic bytes
Verify API inputs are validated and authenticated prior to execution
Verify third-party components are kept up to date and scanned for known CVEs
